title: Don’t take AI’s word for it — this $60 tool double-checks its answers
excerpt: Check AI’s work before you rely on its answer with this browser extension.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get a second opinion on AI answers with this lifetime subscription to Caveat AI Standard Plan, on sale now for $59.99 (reg. $179).

Credit: Caveat AI

$59.99
$179 Save $119.01

AI can be incredibly helpful — until it confidently gives you a wrong answer. If you’re looking for a tool to give you second opinions on answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot, it’s time to meet Caveat AI. This browser extension makes it easy to know which answers to rely on, and right now a lifetime subscription to Caveat AI Standard Plan is just $59.99.

If you’re relying on AI to tackle your daily tasks or even answer basic questions, you’ve probably already realized that it often gives wrong answers. Caveat AI sets out to bridge that gap — adding trust and confidence to your AI answers.

It’s not just another AI tool; Caveat AI works as a browser extension and serves as a fact-check layer for your AI conversations. It supports five platforms — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot — and can detect mission context, flag caution alerts, and even show you a counter-argument AI didn’t mention.

Caveat AI is built on proprietary tech that taps into AI models, letting you rest easy knowing you can confidently work with AI responses. And since it’s an extension, you can review answers without switching tabs.

This lifetime subscription to the Standard Plan provides 20 critical reviews a month. If you need more, it’s easy to purchase extra.

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Lock in this lifetime subscription to Caveat AI Standard Plan, on sale now for $59.99.
